CustomField.description: When checked, EmailService builds the email exactly as configured (template, recipients and queues checked, sender) but sends it only to the dry-run addresses (EmailServiceSettings__c.DryRunAddresses__c), with a subject starting with "DRY RUN - ". The configured To / Cc / Bcc and the Flow's Recipient Id receive nothing.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Check to test this email: it is sent only to the Dry Run Addresses of the Email Service Settings (Custom Setting), with "DRY RUN - " before the subject. The recipients configured here (and the Flow's Recipient Id) receive nothing. Uncheck to go live.
CustomField.label: Dry Run
